Age fit: The words name the four chambers and one blood path, which fits ages 9 to 13.
Whether it teaches the objective: Choosing the left ventricle shows the order blood takes from the lungs out to the body.
Interaction quality: The chamber button is the lesson. The tap names the chamber and traces its path.
Mobile feel: The four chambers are large buttons a thumb can reach on a phone.
Tutor-guide completeness: The guide has an intro, steps, hints, observation prompts, misconceptions, and a success criterion tied to chamber_selected and path_traced.
